title: A Horizon for the Current
premise: Zephyrine Pemberton, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries for a disaster she didn't cause, salvages her living from rivers and ruins along the contested Verlaine coast. When a flood tide delivers a chest stamped with the seal of drowned Vessany—a nation sunk forty years ago and legally erased—she becomes the only person who can reach the wreck before the imperial salvage fleet does, because she alone knows the underwater caverns beneath the Sable Current. Racing six tides alongside a disgraced Vessani archivist, Ivo, whose duty to his dead nation collides with his growing love for her, Zephyrine must decide whether to sell the wreck's proof of imperial treachery for her own pardon or give it back to the scattered Vessani survivors. At the climax she floods the salvage fleet's flagship in the caverns, nearly drowning herself and Ivo, and surfaces with the truth instead of the treasure. In the end she trades her anonymity for justice, accepts exile as the price of survival on her own terms, and finds that a horizon shared is worth more than one kept.
about_author: Marguerite Marchetti is a former river pilot who spent a decade charting tidal waterways across three continents before turning to fiction. She writes adventure novels about people the maps forgot, from a houseboat moored wherever the current allows.

chapters.title: The Weight of Moving On
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. She guides a wealthy client over the Verlaine passes while dodging border patrols, establishing her blacklist and her rule: never stay anywhere past three days. Emotional beat: weary competence masking loneliness.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. After the client departs, she works the flood-swollen Sable Current with her salvage net and pulls up an iron chest bearing the sunken seal of Vessany. Emotional beat: curiosity overriding caution.

chapters.title: Three Days of Grace
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. She pries the chest open in a rented boathouse: documents proving the empire scuttled Vessany's evacuation fleet deliberately. A harbor notice announces an imperial salvage fleet arriving in six tides. Emotional beat: dread crystallizing into resolve.

chapters.title: The Man Who Read Ashes
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Introduced in a coastal archive, cataloguing confiscated Vessani papers, secretly memorizing what he's forbidden to keep. He learns a chest has surfaced. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into purpose.

chapters.title: A Price on Silence
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. A broker offers her a fortune for the chest sight unseen; she realizes whoever sent him already knows she has it. She refuses and prepares to run. Emotional beat: paranoia becoming clarity.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. She charts the fleet's likely route against her knowledge of the submerged caverns below the wreck. Staying invisible was never an option; now speed is everything. Emotional beat: cold arithmetic of survival.

chapters.title: The Archivist's Bargain
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo intercepts Zephyrine at a tide-market, offering his knowledge of Vessani ciphers in exchange for passage to the wreck. She doesn't trust him but needs his decoding skill. Emotional beat: wary alliance struck.

chapters.title: Departure at Slack Water
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. They slip out of harbor aboard her patched ketch, the Cormorant, minutes ahead of the broker's men. First real conversation reveals their mutual exiles. Emotional beat: reluctant respect.

chapters.title: Charts Drawn in Exile
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo decodes the first document: names of Vessani officials the empire drowned rather than ransom. He confesses he survived because he cooperated with the occupiers. Emotional beat: guilt offered like a wound.

chapters.title: The Fleet at Anchor
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. From a headland they watch the salvage fleet—nine ships, dredges, divers—anchored above the wreck site, forcing them toward the cavern approach everyone believes is a death trap. Emotional beat: awe and terror braided together.

chapters.title: Where the Current Bites
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. First attempt through the outer caverns; near-drowning when a surge catches the Cormorant's rudder. Ivo saves her line without being asked. Emotional beat: trust earned in white water.

chapters.title: The Drowned Cathedral
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. They shelter in a vast air-pocketed sea cave frescoed by Vessani refugees; Ivo reads the wall inscriptions aloud, translating a nation's last testament. Emotional beat: mourning made communal.

chapters.title: A Traitor's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Decoded pages reveal the evacuation fleet carried not refugees but the treasury—and the empire knew. Ivo's cooperation forty years ago echoes in his family's collaboration now. Emotional beat: shame transmuted into fury.

chapters.title: Tide Against Tide
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Two tides lost to a storm; the fleet begins dynamiting the reef, which will collapse the caverns. The race tightens from days to hours. Emotional beat: desperation disciplined into planning.

chapters.title: The Broker's Shadow
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. The broker's fast sloop finds them at anchor; a night chase through shoals ends with Zephyrine grounding the pursuer on a sandbar she knows by heart. Emotional beat: fierce joy in her outlaw skills.

chapters.title: What Duty Owes the Dead
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo argues the documents must go to the Vessani diaspora; Zephyrine argues for selling them to buy both their pardons. First true quarrel. Emotional beat: love against duty taking shape.

chapters.title: The Survivor Colony
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. They detour to a hidden cliff village of aging Vessani survivors who recognize Ivo's family name—with contempt. An old woman gives Zephyrine a diver's charm and a warning about the inner caverns. Emotional beat: history refusing to stay buried.

chapters.title: Half a Pardon
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Flashback chapter: the alpine disaster that blacklisted her—an avalanche she predicted, a patron who ignored her, a blame she accepted to protect a friend. Emotional beat: the price of survival revisited.

chapters.title: Signal Fires
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The fleet spots their smoke; a patrol cutter corners them in a fog-bound estuary. Zephyrine rigs decoy fires and they escape through a channel only she can read. Emotional beat: partnership becoming instinct.

chapters.title: The Cipher Beneath
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The final document needs a key kept in the wreck itself—the Vessani captain's strongroom, reachable only through the inner caverns at slack tide. One window, two tides away. Emotional beat: hope with a deadline.

chapters.title: Confession at Low Water
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Stranded waiting for the tide window, Zephyrine tells Ivo the full truth of the avalanche, including the friend she protected. He answers with his own worst day. Emotional beat: intimacy through confessed failure.

chapters.title: The Fleet's New Master
chapters.summary: Antagonist POV. Admiral Corvane, commanding the salvage fleet, is revealed to be the son of the officer who ordered the scuttling; he must destroy the proof before it surfaces. Emotional beat: corruption inherited and embraced.

chapters.title: Into the Inner Dark
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Slack tide. They dive the inner caverns by lamp and counted breaths, past bones and a shattered lifeboat, following Zephyrine's memory of currents no chart records. Emotional beat: terror held at bay by discipline.

chapters.title: The Captain's Strongroom
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. They find the strongroom and the key ledger; Ivo decodes the final page: the admiral's father signed the order, and the treasury was never recovered—it lies in the third cavern. Emotional beat: vindication heavy as stone.

chapters.title: Two Truths, One Chest
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Surfacing, they find the broker waiting on their deck—he boarded during the dive, holding Ivo's decoded copies hostage. He offers Zephyrine her pardon for the originals. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a familiar face.

chapters.title: The Turn
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. She pretends to bargain, then capsizes the sloop in the cavern mouth's suck-current, recovering the copies but losing the original chest to the deep channel. Emotional beat: sacrifice chosen freely at last.

chapters.title: Corvane Closes the Net
chapters.summary: Admiral Corvane's POV. With the fleet's dredges collapsing the outer reef, Corvane seals the cavern exits, deciding to bury the divers and the truth together. Emotional beat: villainy justified as duty.

chapters.title: Trapped Below the World
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Air pocket shrinking, exits sealed, Ivo injured by falling rock. Zephyrine remembers the old woman's warning and finds the third way out—the flooded treasury gallery. Emotional beat: despair converted to ferocity.

chapters.title: The Treasury of Vessany
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the gallery: the lost treasury, untouched, and beside it the skeletons of those meant to carry it home. Ivo understands the nation died twice—once by order, once by abandonment. Emotional beat: sacred grief.

chapters.title: Sixth Tide
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Final tide window. They can take the treasury and outrun nothing, or take the documents and outrun everything. Zephyrine chooses the documents; Ivo seals the gallery behind them so no fleet can ever strip it. Emotional beat: renunciation as victory.

chapters.title: The Flooding of the Flagship
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Climax begins: to escape the sealed lagoon they must pass the fleet. Zephyrine breaches the cavern's pressure wall with salvaged charges, flooding the anchorage and crippling Corvane's flagship in the chaos. Emotional beat: audacity at the edge of suicide.

chapters.title: Admiral Down
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Corvane, drowning in his sinking flagship, refuses rescue until too late, clutching his father's portrait as the Current takes him. Emotional beat: power's corruption completing its circle.

chapters.title: Surface
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. The Cormorant rides the surge out of the collapsing caverns, half-swamped, both half-dead. Behind them the wreck closes forever; ahead, the fleet burns. Emotional beat: survival that feels like rebirth.

chapters.title: Deliverance Refused
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A rescue ship offers them passage and amnesty if they surrender the documents to imperial courts. Zephyrine declines for both of them; Ivo, for the first time, agrees with her. Emotional beat: love choosing duty rightly understood.

chapters.title: The Reading at Salt Harbor
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. In a free-port hall packed with Vessani descendants, Ivo reads the decoded order aloud. The crowd's silence breaks into weeping, then into organized demand. The truth is loose and cannot be repossessed. Emotional beat: catharsis.

chapters.title: Pardons and Prices
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. The empire, scrambling, offers Zephyrine full pardons for both of them to quiet the scandal. She signs nothing; instead she negotiates sanctuary status for the survivor colony. Emotional beat: leverage used generously.

chapters.title: Blacklist No More
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Her name cleared in one country, still barred from another, Zephyrine discovers she no longer wants the old life back. Visibility costs, but invisibility cost more. Emotional beat: identity reclaimed.

chapters.title: Anchorage
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo takes charge of the recovered archive, founding a memorial trust with the colony; he asks Zephyrine to stay, knowing she is built for horizons. Emotional beat: love stated without possession.

chapters.title: The Chart Neither Drew
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. She sails the Cormorant out alone at dawn—but with a course set to return with the season, carrying copies of the truth to every port that will hear it. Emotional beat: freedom and belonging reconciled.

chapters.title: A Horizon for the Current
chapters.summary: Closing dual POV. Months later: Ivo teaching children the Vessani tongue in the cliff village; Zephyrine rounding the headland as the tide turns, the Cormorant's rail lined with new passengers seeking passage through dangerous waters. The current runs on, and so do they. Emotional beat: arrival that is also a beginning.
